text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day as I'm walking along the river, I
spot
Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this poster about? "Running
School:
Students Wanted."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ohhh, one of them super
expensive
schools only rich kids can
attend.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The world's a tough place, huh? Wish
they'd make
room for talented poor folk
too...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Rain?! Can this day get any
worse? I gotta
find cover!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also want to avoid the rain, so I head
toward the
riverbank, where I see...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hi Tama. I'm trying to hide from the
rain.
What about you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Oguri?! I'm doing da
same thing!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Today's just an absolute disaster.
First, I
see that
stupid poster, then I get rained
on outta nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which... Hey, Oguri. You
ever go to
one of those running schools?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Running schools? I'm from the
countryside, so we
didn't have any. You?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I... I couldn't.
I wanted to train hard and make life
a little more comfortable for
me and my family,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But why?! Why can't I go here?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna race! I wanna win! I wanna make loads of money!

text_block_list.name: School Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
That may be, but you still have to pay
for tuition.
Besides, with your... stature,
I'm not so sure you'd do well on our
test...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! My... stature? You haven't
even seen
me run yet! ...Ugh. Whatever!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was turned away at the gate. They shot
me down
without even giving me a
chance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it was rainin' that
day too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Must've been rough... Actually, I've been
told
something similar too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
People scoffed at me for thinking I could
go from running in the country to central
races. They said
I'd never be good
enough for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You too, huh? Sorry you had to go
through that.
People just assume things
about us, but they
don't get us at all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but you can't change the flaws
you're born
with. Someone once told me
that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Flaws? ...I dunno if I'd call them that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, they make life a lot harder,
that's for sure.
But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Damn it! To hell with schools!
Just you
watch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure I'm a shrimp, but I got my body
from my
mom and dad. And I'm gonna
win with it no
matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After getting rejected, I swore I'd prove
'em
wrong one day. I'd show 'em I could
be Naniwa's
top runner.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I've been running toward that
dream ever
since.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not being blessed doesn't mean you're
flawed.
Growin' up poor and scrawny
made me who I am
today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Using everything I was born with is what
gives me
strength!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-the rain...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it finally let up. Let's go,
Oguri. Race
you back to the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll tear past anything with these legs of
mine!
That's why they call me White
Lightning!
